agent_question: Direct research on agent autonomy metrics, memory infrastructure, and personal data context

findings.name: Anthropic Measuring Agent Autonomy
findings.what: Anthropic published real-world data on Claude Code autonomous operation duration and intervention frequency
findings.evidence: Between Oct 2025 and Jan 2026, 99.9th percentile turn duration nearly doubled from under 25 min to over 45 min. Average human interventions per session decreased from 5.4 to 3.3. Success rate on challenging tasks doubled.

findings.name: Claude Opus 4.6 Task Horizon
findings.what: Claude Opus 4.6 crossed a full work-day task horizon at 14.5 hours
findings.evidence: 50% time horizon of approximately 14.5 hours (doubling every 123 days). Claude Opus 4.5 was at 4 hours 49 minutes. Average session length increased from 4 minutes (autocomplete era) to 23 minutes (agentic era).

findings.name: METR Task Horizon Doubling
findings.what: METR tracks task completion time horizons for frontier AI models, finding a 7-month doubling time
findings.evidence: Task length that agents complete with 50% reliability has been doubling every 7 months for 6 years. Time Horizon 1.1 added 34% more tasks (228 total) and doubled 8-hour+ tasks (31 total).

findings.name: OpenAI Codex 25-hour autonomous run
findings.what: Codex ran for 25 hours uninterrupted building a design tool from scratch
findings.evidence: Used ~13M tokens, generated ~30k lines of code. GPT-5.3-Codex achieves 77.3% on Terminal-Bench, 56.8% on SWE-Bench Pro.

findings.name: Mem0 Memory Infrastructure
findings.what: AI agent memory infrastructure company providing persistent cross-session memory
findings.evidence: Raised $24M (Seed + Series A). 186M API calls in Q3 2025. 41K GitHub stars, 13M Python downloads. Graph-based memory with sub-second retrieval.

findings.name: Mem0 Research: Memory Accuracy Boost
findings.what: Research showing persistent memory improves LLM accuracy by 26%
findings.evidence: 26% accuracy improvement when agents have access to structured persistent memory vs. stateless operation.

findings.name: Anthropic Agentic Coding Trends 2026
findings.what: Comprehensive report on how coding agents are reshaping software development
findings.evidence: Documents the shift from autocomplete to agentic coding. Average session 23 minutes. Background tasks, sub-agents, and hooks as autonomy mechanisms.

findings.name: Gartner Agentic AI Forecast
findings.what: Gartner predicts 80% of customer service issues resolved autonomously by 2029
findings.evidence: 80% autonomous resolution rate, 30% operational cost reduction predicted. Current 2026 reality is more nuanced with HITL still required for edge cases.

findings.name: Cognition Labs (Devin)
findings.what: Autonomous coding agent with $10.2B valuation and $73M ARR
findings.evidence: Raised $400M in Sept 2025 at $10.2B valuation. ARR grew from $1M (Sept 2024) to $73M (June 2025). Acquired Windsurf, combined ARR ~$155M. Customers include Goldman Sachs, Cisco, Palantir.

findings.name: Limitless AI (formerly Rewind AI)
findings.what: Personal screen recording + AI recall that pivoted to hardware then was acquired by Meta
findings.evidence: Raised $15M at $350M valuation (May 2023) on $707K ARR (495x multiple). Total $33M+ raised from Altman, a16z, NEA. Acquired by Meta Dec 2025. Desktop app shut down Dec 19, 2025.

findings.name: OpenClaw (daily briefing agent)
findings.what: Open-source personal AI assistant with 210K+ GitHub stars, configurable daily briefings from connected data
findings.evidence: Breakout project of 2026. Surged from 9K to 210K+ stars. Connects to 50+ messaging apps. Users configure cron jobs for morning briefings pulling calendar, email, CRM, weather. Created by PSPDFKit founder.

findings.name: ChatGPT Agent Connectors
findings.what: ChatGPT's built-in connectors for email, calendar, and task management with autonomous scheduling
findings.evidence: Can summarize inbox, find meeting availability, schedule recurring tasks (e.g. weekly metrics reports every Monday). Connectors authenticated per user.

gaps: Specific data on what percentage of human interventions are context-related vs. approval-related
Published comparison of agent performance with vs. without personal user context
Revenue data for agent memory companies (Mem0, Zep)
Academic research specifically on personal data as agent context (most research focuses on task-specific context, not cross-platform personal data)
